name: Mythic Ostrich
body:
MYTHIC OSTRICH
CR 2/MR 1

XP 600
N Medium animal (mythic)
Init +2; Senses low-light vision; Perception +8 (+10 visual)

DEFENSE

AC 14, touch 12, flat-footed 12 (+2 Dex, +2 natural)
hp 21 (2d8+12)
Fort +5, Ref +5, Will +1
Defensive Abilities endless endurance, zigzagma

OFFENSE

Speed 60 ft.
Melee claw +4 (1d6+4)
Special Attacks mythic power (1/day, surge ++1d6)

STATISTICS

Str 17, Dex 14, Con 14, Int 2, Wis 13, Cha 11
Base Atk +1; CMB +4; CMD 16
Feats Enduranceb, Runb MF, Skill Focus (Perception)
Skills Acrobatics +6 (+18 when jumping), Perception +8; Racial Modifier +2 Perception (visual)
SQ crouch

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Crouch (Ex)

An ostrich can hide in plain sight as a bush or shrub by crouching down and concealing its head and legs. It makes a Stealth check as normal, but anyone who observes it from within 30 feet automatically sees through the ruse.

Endless Endurance (Ex)

The mythic ostrich is immune to fatigue and exhaustion and can go up to three days without food or water with no ill effects. If a mythic ostrich takes ability damage, it expends one use of its mythic power as an immediate action to regain 1d4 points of ability damage.

Zigzag (Ex)

When a mythic ostrich uses the withdraw action, its movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity and it gains a +2 dodge bonus to AC until the beginning of its next turn. When it uses the charge action, it can make one turn of up to 90 degrees at any point during its movement.

ECOLOGY

Environment warm deserts or plains
Organization solitary, pair, pride (5–10), or flock (11–50)
Treasure none

The largest and heaviest birds among the common animals, ostriches are swift-running savannah and desert dwellers with black and white feathers on their bodies and thin down covering a neck of pink or blue. Their long legs are covered in tough, almost scaly skin and end in heavy, three-toed claws. While their stubby wings are vestigial, they are known for their exceptional speed, able to outrace most predators, and their wings assist in making rapid changes of direction at high speed. They are largely herbivorous but consume insects, small animals, and carrion when available. They can go for many days with little or no water.
